lines.text: The LORD tells Hosea to show love again to his wife, who is loved by another and is an adulteress.
The LORD says to love her as He loves the Israelites, though they turn to other gods.
Hosea buys his wife for fifteen shekels of silver and a homer and a lethech of wheat.
The Israelites must live many days without king or prince, without sacrifice or sacred pillar, and without ephod or idol.
Afterward, Israel will return and seek the LORD their God and Solomon their king.
